authorization.source: HAR-53 and September15 canonical mission paragraphs

exposure.earlier_human_or_agent_knowledge_not_aud: Held out from this campaign optimizer, not guaranteed unseen in all prior sessions/model training.

omni.unavailable_engines: Explicit blocked-arm report; no replacement or GEPA-only Omni claim.

selection: Highest mean across both fixed development identities; retain original seed on ties or regressions; no automatic adoption.
repeats: One independent paired confirmation per development task after selection; search scores reported separately. If selected artifact is the seed, preserve that identity rather than invent an improved arm.
final: Freeze selected artifact before releasing Lisbon to ordinary native evaluator. Never send final traces/rewards into proposer or choose another artifact after final.
failure_policy: Count all reserved/started/error/aborted attempts; no automatic retries. Infrastructure failures stay excluded from capability denominator, not reward zero. Report partial observed evidence on exhaustion or gates.
inference_limits: Two development identities and one final identity: exploratory workflow/transfer evidence only, not a powered benchmark comparison. Report uncertainty missing where not identifiable.
storage: Existing native jobs, candidate/evaluation receipts, CohortComparisonSpec, primary shared CAS; canonical redacted publication only.
